faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Answers about Sard, our solutions, data privacy, consultations, and partnerships.

f001.q: What is Sard AI, and what does the company do?
f001.a: Sard Integrated Smart Solutions is a technology company based in Alexandria, Egypt, serving organizations across the Arab world, specializing in digital transformation, governance, and AI-powered business solutions. We develop integrated business management systems, websites, e-commerce platforms, and custom applications, alongside process automation and intelligent analytics—helping businesses connect their operations, accelerate growth, and make informed decisions.

f002.q: How does Sard support digital transformation across the Arab world?
f002.a: Sard supports digital transformation and innovation priorities across the Arab world, including Egypt Vision 2030, by developing intelligent solutions tailored to local business needs. Through integrated systems, process automation, e-commerce, and AI-powered analytics, we help businesses strengthen governance, improve productivity, and expand their digital reach, supporting a more competitive, knowledge-based economy.

f003.q: What business processes can Sard AI automate for enterprises?
f003.a: Sard AI automates administrative and technical workflows, data matching and financial reconciliation, and communication workflows with customers, suppliers, and government entities. Tailored to your enterprise’s systems and available integrations, these capabilities reduce manual effort, improve data accuracy, and accelerate business operations.

f004.q: What measurable cost savings or ROI can organizations expect?
f004.a: The strongest ROI comes from automating high-volume tasks, reducing errors and rework, and improving resource utilization. Sard AI assesses each organization’s workflows and cost baseline to estimate potential savings and define measurable success indicators—including operating costs, processing time, and productivity. Sard AI assesses expected ROI and payback periods against implementation and ongoing costs, then validates them through actual results.

f005.q: Where is client data hosted and processed?
f005.a: Client data hosting and processing locations are defined for each project according to business needs, applicable regulations, and the selected service providers—including third-party AI services. Security controls are documented within the agreed scope, covering data isolation, access management, and encryption in transit and at rest. Internationally recognized frameworks guide Sard’s approach: ISO/IEC 27001 for information security, ISO/IEC 27701 for privacy management, ISO 9001 for quality management, and ISO/IEC 42001 for AI management.

f006.q: Does Sard AI store personal consultation or meeting notes in the browser?
f006.a: Sard’s intended privacy approach is to keep consultation details and meeting notes out of persistent browser storage. The exact storage and retention practices depend on the deployed service and should be confirmed in its privacy notice.

f007.q: How can I schedule, view, or cancel a discovery meeting with Sard AI?
f007.a: Book a discovery meeting to explore your business needs and how Sard AI can support your goals. Visit our Calendar page (/calendar) and choose an available slot, Saturday through Thursday, from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Cairo time. To view your booking details, refer to your confirmation message. If you need to cancel, use the cancellation option provided with your booking or contact our team for assistance.

f008.q: Are initial discovery consultations free of charge?
f008.a: Yes. Initial discovery consultations are free when you contact Sard AI to discuss your business needs and explore suitable solutions. On-site visits for requirements assessment, detailed analysis, and specialist consulting are scheduled after a service agreement is signed, within an agreed scope of work.

f009.q: How can our organization establish a strategic partnership with Sard AI?
f009.a: Sard AI welcomes strategic partnerships with organizations across all sectors seeking to advance business governance, digital transformation, and intelligent automation. Whether the opportunity involves joint solution development, technology integration, or market expansion, contact our team with an overview of your organization and collaboration goals. Together, we can define a partnership framework with clear responsibilities, shared value, and measurable outcomes.

recruitment.title: Job and training applications
recruitment.intro: This section explains how Sard handles the information you send through the application form on the Careers page. The rest of this document is still under legal review.

s1.title: What we collect
s1.body: Your name, email and phone number; your city, a LinkedIn or portfolio link and a short note if you add them; your CV (PDF); the opening you applied for; and the date of your application and consent. To protect the form from misuse we also keep a one-way coded (hashed) form of your IP address, not the address itself, and your browser type.

s2.title: Why we use it
s2.body: Only to review your application and to contact you about it or about a suitable opportunity at Sard. We do not use it for marketing, and we do not sell it or share it with others for their own purposes.

s3.title: Who can see it
s3.body: Only authorized members of Sard’s team, through a password-protected administration dashboard. Your CV is kept in private storage that is not publicly accessible, and it is opened only through a temporary link that expires after one minute. The data is stored by the cloud providers that host Sard’s website, on Sard’s behalf.

s4.title: How long we keep it
s4.body: We keep your application only for as long as it is needed for recruitment. You can ask us to delete it at any time.

s5.title: Your choices
s5.body: To see, correct or delete your data, or to withdraw your consent, email us from the address you applied with. Deleting an application also deletes its CV.
